author: Codex documentation author; corrections by DOC-029 source-review author agent (documents)

prerequisites: Signed-in fictional role in its own browser context on the work documentation lab.
Walkthrough-created Contracts and a Matter named "DOC-029 documents ..."; reviewer-built fixture files and a local folder tree built at run time with one nested and one empty folder.
Named browser-network fixtures: one 503 answer for a retryable failure, one 413 answer for a size refusal, and slowed uploads for Cancel remaining.
scenarios.expected: Successful files remain available and the failed item is identified separately. Unsupported folder actions or uploads are refused for the relevant role without claiming the whole batch succeeded.
scenarios.actual: 15 recorded browser steps passed for this role. New folder created an empty folder with no expand control; New subfolder and Rename worked and the parent gained an expand control. A case-only duplicate, a blank name, a slash, . and .. were each refused with a message and nothing was created. Move into omitted the folder and its descendant, the seam refused both cycles with 409, a folder moved under another folder and back to the top level with None. Move to folder with File in filed a Document and None moved it out; a row dragged onto a folder row was filed and dragged onto "Drop here to move out of folders" was moved out; checkboxes and the selection bar Move filed two Documents. Folder Delete said "Anything in it moves onto the contract itself. Nothing is deleted." and left both Documents live. A three-file import showed Destination Record root and Version kind, settled at "Imported 2 of 3 files" with a row Retry and "Retry 1 file", kept the good files as v1 Documents, and the row Retry sent only the failed file. A 413 row had no Retry and Done closed. A fully successful import closed by itself. Cancel remaining settled a slowed five-file import with the queued files cancelled and the uploaded files on the record. Choose folder kept the nested path, dropped the empty folder, and reused the existing folder path on a second import. A local tree dropped on a folder row named that folder as Destination and recreated the empty folder. A Matter import had no Version kind.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the article author and the source reviewer; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.
The folder drop used Chromium DevTools drag events carrying a real local directory, in headless Playwright; drag of Document rows used mouse drag in the same browser. Other browsers were not checked.

Upload failures were browser-network fixtures (503 and 413); a real deployment size limit and a real connection loss were not produced. The unreadable-folder warning for a partly unreadable dropped tree was not produced.
Folder Delete was observed for a top-level folder (contents move onto the record); dissolving a nested folder into its parent was not exercised.
Business User limits (no Choose folder or New folder in the Portal, 403 for folder create and move) are a supplementary business_user step; V-C27 does not require that role.
The shared work lab was used by other agents at the same time; only records named DOC-029 documents ... were created.

compatibilityReview.summary: From 3fa407e3 to 57e77e38, round 2 (DOC-029r2 compatibility reviewer (documents)) found the article compatible: I inspected the app diff from 3fa407e3 to 57e77e38 and found no change to Document, Version, folder, preview, repository, archive or delete behavior or labels; the only Document-surface change is the archived uploader color. I replayed the round 1 documents walkthrough on the work2 lab built from 57e77e38, and all 117 steps passed for Administrator, Legal Team Member and Business User. From 57e77e38 to 432dba3a, round 3 found only apps/web/src/routes/welcome.tsx and its test changed. The wizard now goes to /auth/two-factor/enroll after it saves a policy that requires two-factor authentication. The article makes no statement about the setup wizard Authentication step or two-factor enrollment. The change touches only apps/web/src/routes/welcome.tsx and its test, so no statement in the article can become wrong.
